label: welfare/rights PP linker
explanation: Fires on prepositions (mainly "for", "of", "to", "by", and weakly "on", "in", "against", "towards", "upon", "about") and sometimes the following determiner/quantifier, when they immediately follow a content word that selects a PP complement — especially abstract nouns/adjectives like "life", "lives", "rights", "benefits", "experience", "healthcare", "well-being", "easier" — and the PP object is usually a group of people. Firing is strongest for core "quality of life/rights/benefits for people" phrases (e.g. "life for", "lives of", "healthcare to") and weaker for peripheral or non-human objects (e.g. "wages of sin", "bodies of workers", "except for the possibility"); it stays silent on prepositions in neutral/technical contexts and on non-PP tokens.
